== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Ralltiir (Dark) (Japanese)|Ralltiir]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67776 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(35, 12, 445, 610)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>6fc34a332aba316b0293ccff61268c8b3d5bd060cc61f2f407358d9901545aeb</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-5/5e/Japanese-ANH-Ralltiir-Dark-SWCA-67776.jpg Internet Archive item].
